collection.title: Gender Reveal Party Favors & Gifts
collection.body_html:
Gender Reveal Party Favors

Make your gender reveal celebration memorable with party favors that guests will appreciate. Our collection features practical and keepsake items perfect for thanking friends and family who share in your special announcement.

Favor Options for Your Reveal Party

Gender reveal favors serve as thank you gifts for guests attending your celebration. These items range from edible treats like cookies and candies in pink and blue themes to practical keepsakes such as candles, soaps, and small tokens that commemorate the occasion.

Planning Your Party Favors

Consider your guest count and budget when selecting favors. Popular options include individually wrapped treats, personalized tags or labels, small potted plants, or themed trinkets. Many hosts coordinate favor colors with their reveal theme, incorporating pink, blue, or neutral tones until the big announcement.

Packaging and Presentation

Favor presentation adds to the overall party experience. Simple organza bags, small boxes, or clear containers work well for most items. Add custom tags with your name and reveal date to personalize each favor. Display favors on a dedicated table near the exit or place them at each guest's seat.
